name: AI Mystery Shopper
expected_result: Evidence-backed customer journey score, conversion leaks, prioritized fixes, and retest decision.
allowed_actions: analyze approved CRM timestamps and communications
submit test leads only through explicitly approved test identities and channels
forbidden_actions: place a binding order or booking
use real customer personal data for testing
contact real leads unless separately authorized
human_responsible: Business owner or designated commercial lead

benefit_metric.name: resolved_high_severity_conversion_leaks
benefit_metric.target: >=1 per diagnostic cycle when high-severity leaks exist
benefit_metric.measurement_window: per completed audit and retest cycle

auto_shutdown_condition: Pause live execution after any unauthorized external commitment, personal-data breach, fabricated evidence, or three consecutive audits with no actionable finding and no measurable conversion improvement.

user_opt_out.method: Disable AI Mystery Shopper for the project or channel in Company OS settings.
user_opt_out.previous_data_policy: Previously generated audit artifacts remain according to the project retention policy unless separately deleted by an authorized human.
user_opt_out.service_impact: Audits become manual, slower, less frequent, and less comparable across repeated test cycles.
